name: Edit Methods
description: Settings for interacting with Blender data

props.name: Material Link To
props.description: Toggle whether the material is linked to object data or the object block

items.name: Object Data
items.description: Toggle whether the material is linked to object data or the object block

items.name: Object
items.description: Toggle whether the material is linked to object data or the object block

props.name: Align Object To
props.description: The default alignment for objects added from a 3D viewport menu

items.name: World
items.description: Align newly added objects to the world coordinate system

items.name: View
items.description: Align newly added objects to the active 3D view orientation

items.name: 3D Cursor
items.description: Align newly added objects to the 3D Cursor's rotation

props.name: Enter Edit Mode
props.description: Enter edit mode automatically after adding a new object

props.name: Collection Instance Empty Size
props.description: Display size of the empty when new collection instances are created

props.name: Auto Close Character Pairs
props.description: Automatically close relevant character pairs when typing in the text editor

props.name: Undo Steps
props.description: Number of undo steps available (smaller values conserve memory)

props.name: Undo Memory Size
props.description: Maximum memory usage in megabytes (0 means unlimited)

props.name: Global Undo
props.description: Global undo works by keeping a full copy of the file itself in memory, so takes extra memory

props.name: Auto Keying Enable
props.description: Automatic keyframe insertion for Objects and Bones (default setting used for new Scenes)

props.name: Auto Keying Mode
props.description: Mode of automatic keyframe insertion for Objects and Bones (default setting used for new Scenes)

props.name: Auto Keyframe Insert Available
props.description: Insert Keyframes only for properties that are already animated

props.name: Show Auto Keying Warning
props.description: Show warning indicators when transforming objects and bones if auto keying is enabled

props.name: Default Key Channels
props.description: Which channels to insert keys at when no keying set is active

props.name: Autokey Insert Needed
props.description: Auto-Keying will skip inserting keys that don't affect the animation

props.name: Keyframe Insert Needed
props.description: When keying manually, skip inserting keys that don't affect the animation

props.name: Visual Keying
props.description: Use Visual keying automatically for constrained objects

props.name: New F-Curve Colors - XYZ to RGB
props.description: Color for newly added transformation F-Curves (Location, Rotation, Scale) and also Color is based on the transform axis

props.name: Channel Group Colors
props.description: Use animation channel group colors; generally this is used to show bone group colors

props.name: New Curve Smoothing Mode
props.description: Auto Handle Smoothing mode used for newly added F-Curves

items.name: None
items.description: Automatic handles only take immediately adjacent keys into account

items.name: Continuous Acceleration
items.description: Automatic handles are adjusted to avoid jumps in acceleration, resulting in smoother curves. However, key changes may affect interpolation over a larger stretch of the curve.

props.name: New Interpolation Type
props.description: Interpolation mode used for first keyframe on newly added F-Curves (subsequent keyframes take interpolation from preceding keyframe)

items.name: Constant
items.description: No interpolation, value of A gets held until B is encountered

items.name: Linear
items.description: Straight-line interpolation between A and B (i.e. no ease in/out)

items.name: Bézier
items.description: Smooth interpolation between A and B, with some control over curve shape

items.name: Sinusoidal
items.description: Sinusoidal easing (weakest, almost linear but with a slight curvature)

items.name: Quadratic
items.description: Quadratic easing

items.name: Cubic
items.description: Cubic easing

items.name: Quartic
items.description: Quartic easing

items.name: Quintic
items.description: Quintic easing

items.name: Exponential
items.description: Exponential easing (dramatic)

items.name: Circular
items.description: Circular easing (strongest and most dynamic)

items.name: Back
items.description: Cubic easing with overshoot and settle

items.name: Bounce
items.description: Exponentially decaying parabolic bounce, like when objects collide

items.name: Elastic
items.description: Exponentially decaying sine wave, like an elastic band

props.name: New Handles Type
props.description: Handle type for handles of new keyframes

items.name: Free
items.description: Completely independent manually set handle

items.name: Aligned
items.description: Manually set handle with rotation locked together with its pair

items.name: Vector
items.description: Automatic handles that create straight lines

items.name: Automatic
items.description: Automatic handles that create smooth curves

items.name: Auto Clamped
items.description: Automatic handles that create smooth curves which only change direction at keyframes

props.name: Allow Negative Frames
props.description: Current frame number can be manually set to a negative value

props.name: Unselected F-Curve Opacity
props.description: The opacity of unselected F-Curves against the background of the Graph Editor

props.name: Only Show Selected F-Curve Keyframes
props.description: Only keyframes of selected F-Curves are visible and editable

props.name: F-Curve High Quality Drawing
props.description: Draw F-Curves using Anti-Aliasing (disable for better performance)

props.name: Grease Pencil Manhattan Distance
props.description: Pixels moved by mouse per axis when drawing stroke

props.name: Grease Pencil Euclidean Distance
props.description: Distance moved by mouse when drawing stroke to include

props.name: Grease Pencil Eraser Radius
props.description: Radius of eraser 'brush'

props.name: Annotation Default Color
props.description: Color of new annotation layers

props.name: Sculpt/Paint Overlay Color
props.description: Color of texture overlay

props.name: Connect Movie Strips by Default
props.description: Connect newly added movie strips by default if they have multiple channels

props.name: Duplicate Mesh
props.description: Causes mesh data to be duplicated with the object

props.name: Duplicate Surface
props.description: Causes surface data to be duplicated with the object

props.name: Duplicate Curve
props.description: Causes curve data to be duplicated with the object

props.name: Duplicate Lattice
props.description: Causes lattice data to be duplicated with the object

props.name: Duplicate Text
props.description: Causes text data to be duplicated with the object

props.name: Duplicate Metaball
props.description: Causes metaball data to be duplicated with the object

props.name: Duplicate Armature
props.description: Causes armature data to be duplicated with the object

props.name: Duplicate Camera
props.description: Causes camera data to be duplicated with the object

props.name: Duplicate Speaker
props.description: Causes speaker data to be duplicated with the object

props.name: Duplicate Light
props.description: Causes light data to be duplicated with the object

props.name: Duplicate Material
props.description: Causes material data to be duplicated with the object

props.name: Duplicate Action
props.description: Causes actions to be duplicated with the data-blocks

props.name: Duplicate Particle
props.description: Causes particle systems to be duplicated with the object

props.name: Duplicate Light Probe
props.description: Causes light probe data to be duplicated with the object

props.name: Duplicate Grease Pencil
props.description: Causes Grease Pencil data to be duplicated with the object

props.name: Duplicate Curves
props.description: Causes curves data to be duplicated with the object

props.name: Duplicate Point Cloud
props.description: Causes point cloud data to be duplicated with the object

props.name: Duplicate Volume
props.description: Causes volume data to be duplicated with the object

props.name: Duplicate Node Tree
props.description: Make copies of node groups when duplicating nodes in the node editor

props.name: Auto-offset
props.description: Automatically offset the following or previous nodes in a chain when inserting a new node

props.name: Auto-offset Margin
props.description: Minimum distance between nodes for Auto-offsetting nodes

props.name: Node Preview Resolution
props.description: Resolution used for Shader node previews (should be changed for performance convenience)

props.name: Cursor Lock Adjust
props.description: Place the cursor without 'jumping' to the new location (when lock-to-cursor is used)

props.name: Cursor Surface Project
props.description: Use the surface depth for cursor placement
